query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_companies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN enrichmentData IS NULL OR enrichmentData = '' OR enrichmentData = 'null' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_enrichment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fitScore IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_fit_score,
  SUM(CASE WHEN briefData IS NULL OR briefData = '' OR briefData = 'null' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_brief,
  SUM(CASE WHEN salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '' OR salesApproachData = 'null' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_sales_approach,
  SUM(CASE WHEN logoUrl IS NULL OR logoUrl = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_logo,
  SUM(CASE WHEN imageUrl IS NULL OR imageUrl = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_image
FROM companies 
WHERE searchId = 1500003;
